project.name: Navier–Stokes Lean formalization
project.activity: Very new public repository; 2 commits visible at review time.
project.licenseNote: GitHub API reports license=null and the recursive repository tree contains no LICENSE file. Public visibility does not grant reuse rights.
project.overview: Research repository accompanying a 79-page paper on finite-time blow-up for Navier–Stokes. It contains a Lean 4.33.1/Mathlib formalization: challenge files state theorems and Solution.lean proves them from Breakdown. The repository README explicitly says the numerical certificate and its 128-bit interval-arithmetic verification are not included.
project.requirements: Lean 4.33.1, Lake, and Mathlib at revision 0df444a360eaa60ab8c11dca51a86af692955474. The project is a large Lean library (README estimates about 2,270 files and 600,000 lines); expect substantial memory and build time.
project.quickStart: From the lean/ directory, run `lake exe cache get` followed by `lake build`. The patched package dated 20 November was not rebuilt when the repository was assembled, so a successful build must not be assumed.
project.costs: No paid API or hosted inference service is described. The main cost is local or CI compute, storage, and time for a large Lean/Mathlib build. No build was run in this review.
project.localVsCloud: The repository is a local Lean/Lake package. It can be built on a suitably provisioned local machine or CI runner; there is no built-in cloud service or hosted execution tier.
project.alternatives: The accompanying PDF is the primary mathematical exposition. Other proof assistants or independent formalizations could provide separate checks, but none was evaluated here as a drop-in alternative.
project.limitations: The numerical certificate and interval-arithmetic verification program are absent; the patched Lean package was not rebuilt; the repository has only two commits; no LICENSE file was found; the claim requires independent mathematical review. No testEvidence is claimed.

improvements.title: حزمة تحقق قابلة لإعادة الإنتاج للشهادة العددية
improvements.problem: README يذكر أن الشهادة العددية وحساب الفواصل غير موجودين في المستودع، وأن النسخة المعدلة لم يُعَد بناؤها.
improvements.approach: نشر الشهادة مع بصمتها، وتوثيق أداة التحقق وإصداراتها، وفصل بناء Lean عن التحقق العددي، ثم حفظ سجلات بناء قابلة للمراجعة.
improvements.stack: Lean 4.33.1, Lake, Mathlib pinned revision, Arb/FLINT interval arithmetic, GitHub Actions
steps: تثبيت toolchain وMathlib على المراجعات المحددة.
نشر ملف الشهادة وبصمة SHA-256 بعد إتاحته رسميًا.
توثيق مدخلات وخطوات حساب الفواصل ذات 128 بت.
إضافة CI يبني Lean ويشغّل أداة التحقق عندما تصبح الشهادة متاحة.
حفظ سجلات البناء والتحقق مع كل إصدار.
improvements.metric: نجاح بناء نظيف قابل لإعادة الإنتاج، ونجاح تحقق الشهادة، وإمكانية إعادة النتيجة من طرف مستقل.
improvements.risks: الشهادة غير متاحة حاليًا، والبناء مكلف حسابيًا، وغياب الترخيص الواضح يقيّد إعادة الاستخدام.
